zh.title: 请求经过了策略，干预就生效了吗？
zh.summary: 比较代理路由与动作钩子的证据边界，用固定源码的局部方法探针说明：路径覆盖清单和干预输入输出必须分别验收。

en.title: A Request Reached Policy. What Intervention Actually Happened?
en.summary: A comparison of proxy routing and action hooks separates path-coverage evidence from intervention semantics, using bounded probes of pinned source methods.
